The '''WantedSort''' extension provides '''Special:WantedSort''', a filterable and sortable report of [[Help:Wanted pages|wanted pages]] (titles that are linked but do not exist). It is an alternative to core {{ll|Help:Special pages|Special:WantedPages}} when editors need namespace filters, flexible sort order, CSV export, or a CLI dump.

Developed for [https://saintapedia.org/ Saintapedia].

== Features ==

* Filter by namespace
* Sort by link count, title, or namespace (ascending or descending)
* Configurable page size and previous/next navigation
* CSV export for logged-in users (capped; formula-injection hardened)
* Maintenance script dump: <code>csv</code>, <code>tsv</code>, or <code>wiki</code>
* WAN cache for result pages; tighter caps under {{ll|Manual:$wgMiserMode|$wgMiserMode}}
* Optional default namespace via <code>$wgWantedSortDefaultNamespace</code>
* Subpage / query pre-filter (e.g. <code>Special:WantedSort/Category</code>)

The SQL shape matches modern core WantedPages (threshold, missing-page join, exclusion of user-space targets and MediaWiki-namespace sources, redirect handling).

== Installation ==

{{ExtensionInstall
|WantedSort
|registration=required
|download-link=[https://github.com/Saintapedia/WantedSort/releases GitHub releases]
|custom-steps=* Optional: create a local '''Help:WantedSort''' page from the [https://github.com/Saintapedia/WantedSort/blob/v1.0.2/docs/Help-WantedSort.wikitext help wikitext] in the repository for editors.
}}

Clone a release tag:

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
cd extensions/
git clone --branch v1.0.2 --depth 1 \
  https://github.com/Saintapedia/WantedSort.git WantedSort
</syntaxhighlight>

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
wfLoadExtension( 'WantedSort' );
</syntaxhighlight>

No database schema update is required.

== Configuration ==

; <code>$wgWantedSortDefaultNamespace</code>
: Integer namespace ID to pre-select when the user has not chosen a namespace (and no subpage / query override). Default: <code>null</code> (all namespaces).
; <code>$wgWantedPagesThreshold</code>
: Core setting. Minimum incoming links for a title to appear. Same semantics as Special:WantedPages.
; <code>$wgMiserMode</code>
: Core setting. When true, lowers page-size options, caps deep offsets, lengthens cache TTL, and lowers the CSV export cap.
; <code>$wgRateLimits['wantedsort-export']</code>
: Optional. Throttles web CSV export for logged-in users. Example:

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
$wgWantedSortDefaultNamespace = NS_CATEGORY; // 14

$wgRateLimits['wantedsort-export'] = [
	'user' => [ 10, 60 ], // 10 exports per minute
];
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Namespace selection priority ===

# <code>?namespace=</code> query parameter (empty = all)
# Special page subpage (name or ID)
# <code>$wgWantedSortDefaultNamespace</code>
# All namespaces

== Special:WantedSort ==

Editors use the filter form to choose namespace, sort field, direction, and page size. Results show the missing title, namespace, link count, and a link to {{ll|Help:What links here|Special:WhatLinksHere}}.

=== CSV export ===

Logged-in users can download the '''filtered''' set (not only the current page):

* UI: '''Export to CSV'''
* URL: <code>Special:WantedSort?…&export=csv</code>

Columns: <code>title</code>, <code>namespace</code>, <code>namespace_id</code>, <code>links</code>. Caps: 5,000 rows (1,000 under miser mode). Anonymous users are sent to login. Export can be rate-limited with <code>$wgRateLimits['wantedsort-export']</code>.

== Maintenance script ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
php maintenance/run.php extensions/WantedSort/maintenance/DumpWantedSort.php \
  --namespace 14 --limit 1000 --format csv > wanted.csv
</syntaxhighlight>

{| class="wikitable"
! Option !! Default !! Description
|-
| <code>--namespace</code> || all || Integer namespace ID (not a name string)
|-
| <code>--sort</code> || <code>links</code> || <code>links</code>, <code>title</code>, or <code>namespace</code>
|-
| <code>--dir</code> || <code>desc</code> || <code>asc</code> or <code>desc</code>
|-
| <code>--limit</code> || <code>1000</code> || Max rows (hard max 50,000)
|-
| <code>--format</code> || <code>csv</code> || <code>csv</code>, <code>tsv</code>, or <code>wiki</code>
|}

== Caching ==

Each result page is cached in the main WAN object cache (5 minutes normally; 1 hour under miser mode). This is not a full {{ll|Manual:QueryPage.php|QueryPage}} / <code>querycache</code> rewrite; live <code>GROUP BY</code> queries still run on cache miss.
